title: Bumblebee with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="eyeGlow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffb300"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sparkle" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#aaddff"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Wings -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="28" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#aaddff" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(-25 30 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="28" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#aaddff" opacity="0.85" transform="rotate(25 70 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="32" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8" transform="rotate(-15 28 32)"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="32" rx="13" ry="8" fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8" transform="rotate(15 72 32)"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#ffcc00"/>

  <!-- Stripes -->
  <rect x="24" y="52" width="52" height="8" rx="4" fill="#5c3d99"/>
  <rect x="26" y="68" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#5c3d99"/>

  <!-- Stinger -->
  <polygon points="50,82 46,92 54,92" fill="#5c3d99"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="14" fill="#ffcc00"/>

  <!-- Antennae -->
  <line x1="42" y1="32" x2="36" y2="20" stroke="#5c3d99" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="32" x2="64" y2="20" stroke="#5c3d99" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="19" r="3" fill="#ff4488"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="19" r="3" fill="#ff4488"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="41" r="6" fill="url(#eyeGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="41" r="6" fill="url(#eyeGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="41" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a4e"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="41" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a4e"/>

  <!-- Sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="39.5" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="42.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="39.5" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="42.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Extra sparkle accents -->
  <path d="M46 34 l1 -3 l1 3 l3 1 l-3 1 l-1 3 l-1 -3 l-3 -1 z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M58 33 l0.8 -2.5 l0.8 2.5 l2.5 0.8 l-2.5 0.8 l-0.8 2.5 l-0.8 -2.5 l-2.5 -0.8 z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M45 47 Q50 51 55 47" stroke="#5c3d99" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="46" r="3" fill="#ff88aa" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="46" r="3" fill="#ff88aa" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
